description: This file defines Express.js routes for user-related operations, including fetching, creating, updating, deleting users, seeding demo data, and retrieving user projects from sessions. It also includes Swagger API documentation for these endpoints.

methods.name: router.get('/seed-if-empty')
methods.description: Endpoint to seed demo users into the database if the 'users' collection is empty, then responds with counts and a sample.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a paginated and optionally filtered list of users. It includes logic to auto-seed the collection if empty.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a user by their ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new user document.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing user by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a user by ID.

methods.name: router.get('/:userId/projects')
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch projects associated with a user based on session activity, with optional time range filters.
